themes.name: Manual processes don't scale
themes.summary: Multiple companies describe manual spreadsheet-based infringement tracking that breaks down as volume grows. Teams spend hours on data entry and categorization that could be automated.

themes.name: Budget exists but requires ROI proof
themes.summary: Decision makers are willing to spend $1500-3000/month but need concrete time savings or revenue impact data before approving.

contradictions.description: Some teams prioritize speed of detection while others prioritize accuracy of categorization

validate_next: How much time do legal teams spend on cases that disappear before action?
